utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t seen the repair drive set up yet—do you know where they’re taking donations?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — let’s start with what’s already covered so we don’t duplicate anything. I’ll pull up the list, and we can mark off the items that are done.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That works for me — can you check whether the donation spot is the community shop? I’m keeping an eye out, too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn — I’m still waiting on the details, but I’ll pass them along as soon as I get them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course, Nell — just let me know when you have them, and I’ll spread the word right away.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know as soon as I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll stop by if I can—thanks for letting me know. I’ll bring anything extra I can spare.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That would be great, Cleo. Just let me know if you hear what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure thing—I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I hear what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, thanks for the reminder—sorting the donated tools and making a quick list of what’s missing still need doing. I can help with that; just point me where to start.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Oren — could you start by sorting the donated tools, then jot down what’s still missing? I’ll check the timing and keep the list updated as we go.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll sort the donated tools first and then make a quick missing-items list. Just send me any updates, and I’ll keep going.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m not sure yet, but I can check the school bulletin and let you know. If I find it, I’ll send you the details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Faye — that’d help a lot. I’m a bit blank on the last repair, so if you find it, please let me know.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely—I’ll check the school bulletin and let you know as soon as I find the donation details.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Uli — I can lend out what I’ve got for the repair drive. If you hear anyone needs tools or spare parts, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Gus — I appreciate it. I’ll let you know if anyone needs anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, thanks, Uli — I appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m out running errands now, but I’ll check back in later and let you know if I hear what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Ira. Let me know what still needs to be picked up, and I’ll see if I can help with tools or a ride.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll ask around while I’m out and let you know if I hear whether it’s tools, a ride, or anything else they still need.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, that’d help. I’d like to know if they still need tape and a couple screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll ask around and repeat that they still need tape and a couple screwdrivers. If anyone has extras, I’ll send them your way.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Much appreciated. Let me know what you find out, and I’ll keep things ready here.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Tess—happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll check whether they still need tape and a couple of screwdrivers, and I’ll let you know what I hear.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Tess—thanks. Let me know if they still need tools or tape, and I’ll help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still not 100% sure, so I’d like to double-check the schedule and transport before I confirm. Once I know who’s bringing what, I can say for sure.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — please let me know once you’ve confirmed. I’d rather wait for the details before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I will — I’m checking the timing and transport now, and I’ll let you know as soon as I’ve confirmed the details.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure, I can help with that — I’ll start at the tool table and sort through the donated parts.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good, thanks. Once you’ve got them sorted, bring the filler over and I’ll point out the cracked edge and the loose patch.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll sort the parts first, then bring the filler over to you.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be a huge help, Noah. Could you start by sorting the donated items, and if you can, ask a couple neighbors to join in?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can sort the donated items and I’ll ask a couple neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Bo — that helps a lot. Start with the donated items, and if you can, just let me know who’s willing to help.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good morning, Dane. Did Tess hear back yet about whether they still need tape and screwdrivers?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I haven’t heard from Tess yet, but I can check and let you know. In the meantime, I’ll start with the tool table and see if we’re still short on tape and screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Dane. Please let me know what you find at the tool table.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 10 should still work for me after the school run. If you hear where they’re taking donations, let me know and I’ll help coordinate.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—I’ll let you know if I hear where they’re taking donations.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo—I'll keep my phone on after the school run in case anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Gus. Bring the shovel and filler when you can, and I’ll show you the cracked edge and the loose patch.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it, Leo—I’ll bring the shovel and filler over soon. I’m glad to help patch things up.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Appreciate it, Gus. I’ll be around by the curb when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can do that—I'll bring a shovel and some filler. Just point me to the spots when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Sam—thank you. I’ll mark the spots and have the list ready when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Rosa—I’ll swing by with the shovel and filler and look for your marks.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’ve got the fence panels and the community room faucet. If the other repair comes to you, let me know so I can keep the list accurate.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Will do — I’ll let you know if it comes up. Thanks for keeping the list straight.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Uli — I appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s so kind of you, Cleo — thank you! Just come by whenever you can, and anything you bring will really help the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: You’re welcome — I’ll drop by as soon as I can and bring whatever extra supplies I’ve got. Thanks for organizing it, Quinn!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Cleo — that means a lot. See you when you can make it, and I’ll make sure everything’s ready for you.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll ask around for a car or van and see who can help with tools. Tuesday after 3 or Thursday morning still works, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, that still works for me. If you can confirm the vehicle, I’ll plan around Tuesday after 3 or Thursday morning.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll start lining up a vehicle and ask around for tools. I’ll let you know as soon as I’ve got something confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard folks are really pitching in for it. I’m headed out to run a few errands, but I can check on what’s still needed when I get back.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Ira — please do check when you’re back and let me know. I’m waiting to confirm before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’ll check as soon as I’m back and let you know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks — I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive and let everyone know you’re starting with the tool table. If you need anything else, just tell me and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks Vik — I’ll get started at the tool table and keep an eye out for anything else that needs sorting.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good, Jules — I’ll keep letting folks know the plan is underway and that you’re on the tool table. If anything else turns up, I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll sort the donated tools and jot down a missing-items list. Just point me to where the boxes are.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Oren—I'll point you right to the boxes. And I’ll still ask around about tape and screwdrivers in case they’re short.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Perfect, thanks—I'll get the tools sorted and make that missing-items list now. Just show me where to start.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rey — we still need a few tools, some volunteer hands, and help sorting the donated items. If you can, just tell me where you’d like to start.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can start with sorting the donated items. Just point me to the pile and I’ll get going.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — the donated items are by the community hall entrance. Thanks, Rey, and let me know if you need help finding anything.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Nell—I’d appreciate that. I’ll keep an eye out too in case I spot the donation location.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Opal — if I hear the details first, I’ll pass them right along.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks, Nell. I’ll check around my place too and let you know if I spot where they’re taking donations.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
